title: Streetfighter V2 Storm Green (Special Edition)
description: Within the Urban Roadster segment, the Ducati Streetfighter V2 Storm Green (Special Edition) is crafted for flickable urban agility and stoplight-to-stoplight punch. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against its responsive chassis architecture, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. The cockpit is configured with an Upright Neutral riding stance and a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
